games.name: American Offroad Delivery [UPD]
games.desc:
American Offroad Delivery is an adrenaline-pumping driving simulation where players become expert cargo drivers, navigating across the diverse and rugged landscapes of the United States. From the bustling streets of cities to the wild, untamed off-road trails, your mission is to deliver goods safely and on time, facing unpredictable challenges along the way.

Choose from a range of rugged American vehicles, each designed to tackle specific terrains, whether it's a powerful 4x4 truck for off-roading, a sturdy van for city deliveries, or a heavy-duty rig for transporting large and tough cargo. The more you deliver, the more you can customize and upgrade your vehicles to take on even tougher routes.

Embark on the ultimate American off-road adventure in American Offroad Delivery. Your skills as a driver will be tested as you conquer the toughest terrains and deliver your cargo through the heart of America’s wildest landscapes!

games.name: Milwaukee Gang Wars 2024
games.desc:
⚠️ READ DESCRIPTION OF GAMEPASSES BEFORE BUYING ANY GAMEPASSES!!
2027 UPDATE!!
Welcome to MGW , a gritty, fast-paced urban roleplay game inspired by street culture, high-risk choices, and real consequences.

Step into a detailed city where crime, law enforcement, and everyday life collide. Choose your role and create your own story — whether you’re a civilian trying to survive, a criminal chasing fast money and faster cars, or a police officer sworn to protect the city.

🔫 Core Features

• Multiple roles: Police, Criminals, and Civilians
• Firearms, tactical gear, and law enforcement tools
• High-speed chases, arrests, investigations, and escapes
• Realistic interactions and decision-based outcomes
• A living city where actions have consequences

🚓 Law vs Crime

Police officers patrol the streets, respond to calls, conduct traffic stops, and pursue suspects. Criminals plan robberies, evade law enforcement, and navigate dangerous situations. Civilians must adapt to the city’s tension.
